name: BILL
description: BILL (Bill.com) accounts payable and receivable: vendors, bills, recurring bills, vendor credits, bill approvals and approval policies, AP payments, customers, invoices, credit memos and received payments. BILL v3 API with a developer key and user sign-in; approving bills is included but installed switched off.
prerequisites: A BILL developer key and the organization id, both on Settings → Sync & Integrations → Manage Developer Keys in the BILL web app (an administrator generates the key), plus the e-mail and password of a BILL user of that organization.
instructions:
## BILL
BILL (formerly Bill.com) runs accounts payable (vendors, bills, approvals, payments) and accounts receivable (customers, invoices, received payments) for US businesses. This connector uses the BILL v3 API, read-only by default.

## Setup
1. BILL API access needs a **developer key** (`devKey`). An administrator generates it in the BILL web app: **Settings → Sync & Integrations → Manage Developer Keys → Generate developer key** (production), or in a sandbox developer account from the BILL developer portal sign-up (https://developer.bill.com).
2. `BILL_USERNAME` and `BILL_PASSWORD`: the e-mail and password of a BILL user of that organization. Use a dedicated API user; its role limits what the API can see and do.
3. `BILL_ORGANIZATION_ID`: shown at the bottom of the same Manage Developer Keys page; it starts with `008`.
4. `BILL_API_URL`: `https://gateway.prod.bill.com/connect` for production, `https://gateway.stage.bill.com/connect` for the sandbox. A sandbox devKey does not work on production and the reverse.

The connector signs in with `POST /v3/login` and sends the returned `sessionId` and the `devKey` as headers on every call. A session expires after 35 minutes without activity; the connector signs in again by itself. The login limit is 200 per developer key per hour.

## Start here
- `bill_com_get_session` checks the sign-in.
- Payables: `bill_com_list_bills` with `filters=paymentStatus:in:"UNPAID,PARTIAL"` and `sort=dueDate:asc`; `bill_com_list_pending_approvals` for what waits for you.
- Receivables: `bill_com_list_invoices` with `filters=status:in:"OPEN,PARTIAL_PAYMENT"`.

## Filters, sort, pages
`filters` is `field:operator:value`, several separated by commas (AND). Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, sw (starts with). Quote values that contain commas or times: `createdTime:gte:"2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z"`, `paymentStatus:in:"UNPAID,PARTIAL"`. Not every field is filterable; common ones: vendors/customers `name` (eq, sw), `archived`, `createdTime`, `updatedTime`; bills `vendorId`, `dueDate`, `paymentStatus`; invoices `customerId`, `status`; payments `vendorId`, `processDate`, `status`. `sort` is `field:asc|desc`. `max` up to 100 (default 20). For the next page pass `page` = the `nextPage` value from the answer, without filters and sort.

## Ids
BILL ids have type prefixes: vendors `009`, bills `00n`, customers `0cu`, invoices `00e`, payments `stp`, organizations `008`.

## Limits
20,000 requests per developer key per hour and 3 concurrent requests per organization; errors BDC_1144 and BDC_1322 mean wait and retry.

## Writes
Approving or denying bills is included but installed switched off. Payments, bill and invoice creation are not part of this connector.

BILL_API_URL.label: API environment
BILL_API_URL.help: https://gateway.prod.bill.com/connect for production, https://gateway.stage.bill.com/connect for the sandbox.
BILL_API_URL.patternMessage: Use https://gateway.prod.bill.com/connect or https://gateway.stage.bill.com/connect, without a trailing slash.

BILL_DEV_KEY.label: Developer key (devKey)
BILL_DEV_KEY.help: BILL web app → Settings → Sync & Integrations → Manage Developer Keys → Generate developer key. Sandbox keys come with a sandbox developer account.

BILL_ORGANIZATION_ID.label: Organization id
BILL_ORGANIZATION_ID.help: Shown at the bottom of Settings → Sync & Integrations → Manage Developer Keys in the BILL web app. Starts with 008.
BILL_ORGANIZATION_ID.patternMessage: A BILL organization id starts with 008.

BILL_USERNAME.label: BILL user e-mail
BILL_USERNAME.help: E-mail address of a BILL user in that organization. A dedicated API user is recommended.
BILL_USERNAME.patternMessage: The e-mail address you sign in to BILL with.

verifyHints.400: BILL refused the sign-in. Check the e-mail, password, organization id and developer key, and that the developer key belongs to the same environment as the API URL.
verifyHints.401: BILL rejected the session or developer key. Check the developer key and that the API URL matches its environment (production or sandbox).
verifyHints.403: The BILL user's role does not allow this. Use a user with Administrator or Accountant rights.
verifyHints.rate_limited: BILL limits 20,000 requests per developer key per hour, 200 sign-ins per hour and 3 concurrent requests. Wait and try again.

tools.name: bill_com_get_session
tools.description: Get the current API session: organization id, user id and whether the session is MFA trusted. No parameters; use it to check the sign-in.

tools.name: bill_com_list_organizations
tools.description: List the BILL organizations the signed-in user can access, with organization id and name, including Accountant Console organizations. Up to 100 per page.

page.description: nextPage value from the previous answer.

tools.name: bill_com_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (payees) with id, name, contact, address, payment details status, bill currency and balance. Filter by name, archived, payment status or change time.

filters.description: Comma-separated field:operator:value conditions, e.g. name:sw:"Acme",archived:eq:false or updatedTime:gte:"2026-09-01". Quote values with commas or times.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. name:asc or createdTime:desc.

page.description: nextPage or prevPage value from the previous answer. Send it without filters and sort.

tools.name: bill_com_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by id with contact data, address, payment method and network status, bill currency, balance and accounting links.

tools.name: bill_com_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (AR) with id, name, contact, address, invoice currency, balance and whether they can be charged. Filter by name, archived or change time.

filters.description: Comma-separated field:operator:value conditions, e.g. name:sw:"Acme",archived:eq:false. Quote values with commas or times.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. name:asc.

page.description: nextPage or prevPage value from the previous answer. Send it without filters and sort.

tools.name: bill_com_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id with contact data, billing and shipping address, payment terms, invoice currency and balance.

filters.description: Comma-separated field:operator:value conditions, e.g. vendorId:eq:"009...",paymentStatus:in:"UNPAID,PARTIAL",dueDate:lte:"2026-10-31". Quote values with commas or times.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. dueDate:asc.

page.description: nextPage or prevPage value from the previous answer. Send it without filters and sort.

tools.name: bill_com_get_bill
tools.description: Get one bill by id with vendor, invoice number, dates, line items with accounts and classifications, amounts, payment status and approval status.

tools.name: bill_com_list_recurring_bills

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. createdTime:desc.

page.description: nextPage or prevPage value from the previous answer. Send it without filters and sort.

page.description: nextPage or prevPage value from the previous answer. Send it without filters and sort.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. dueDate:asc or createdTime:desc.

tools.name: bill_com_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one AR invoice by id with customer, number, dates, line items, totals, amount due, status and payment link details.

tools.description: Get one AP payment by id with vendor, amount, funding account, process and expected arrival dates, status, disbursement type and bills paid.

tools.name: bill_com_list_received_payments
tools.description: List payments received from customers (AR) with customer, amount, payment date, type, status and the invoices they settle. Filter by customer, date or status.

filters.description: Comma-separated field:operator:value conditions, e.g. customerId:eq:"0cu...",paymentDate:gte:"2026-10-01". Quote values with commas or times.

sort.description: field:asc or field:desc, comma-separated, e.g. paymentDate:desc.

tools.name: bill_com_get_received_payment
tools.description: Get one received payment by id with customer, amount, payment date, method, status and the invoices it was applied to.

tools.name: bill_com_list_pending_approvals
tools.description: List the bills waiting for approval by the signed-in user, with bill, vendor, amount and due date. Use it before approving or denying bills.

tools.name: bill_com_list_approval_policies
tools.description: List the bill approval policies of the organization: rules (for example amount thresholds or vendors) and the approvers in order.

tools.name: bill_com_approve_or_deny_bills
tools.description: Approve or deny bills waiting for the signed-in user's approval, with an optional comment per bill. Approved bills can then be paid. Returns the result per bill.
